# `silk/platform/wasm/thread`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

The wasi-threads records of a multi-threaded wasm32 module.

## When to use
`NativeThread` starts and joins wasm32 threads through `WasmThread`. Applications use
`silk.concurrency.thread_native`.

## Details
Each thread owns a record and a 1 MiB stack from the module's heap. The host starts the thread
as a new instance on the shared memory and calls the module's `wasi_thread_start`, which the
compiler defines: it moves the shadow stack to the record's stack top, calls the entry module's
thread entry, then marks the record done and wakes the joiner. The joiner releases the stack and
the record only after it sees the record done, which the thread sets after its last stack use.
